name: Apology
overview: Scripture teaches that apology is an essential aspect of Christian relationships, involving both confession and forgiveness. Believers are instructed to lovingly rebuke a brother who sins, and upon genuine repentance, to forgive him, reflecting the kindness and tenderheartedness God has shown through Christ. Confessing faults to one another is encouraged to promote healing and spiritual restoration, underscoring the power of righteous prayer. This dynamic of apology and forgiveness mirrors the profound love God demonstrated by sending His Son for our salvation.
